question: What preliminary conclusions are supported by a frozen prefix of the active O0 planning run and already-reviewed binding/probes?
hypothesis: The observed prefix may expose a task-utility gap despite numerically valid computation; only complete paired runs can satisfy the final protocol.

sources.sections: Section 4.4, Section 5.1.1 and Appendix A.10, read before this interim analysis
sources.consequence: Keep fixed task/horizon/CEM and physical success metrics; separate decoded physical information from planning utility and do not treat partial observations as five completed groups or replicated training seeds.

sources.sections: Appendix B.1-B.2, D.2 and G, read before this interim analysis
sources.consequence: Object masking alters available representations; Hungarian matching addresses slot ordering but does not establish object binding or causal identification. Local balls open-loop planning differs from paper Push-T MPC.

sources.sections: Appendix B.4, read before this interim analysis
sources.consequence: Non-object groupings can occur under reconstruction in the paper mixer-decoder setting. Our RGB mixture decoder differs; this supports a hypothesis only, not attribution.

differences: User-requested interim descriptive readout of an already running B001 experiment. No new model execution, training, metrics, thresholds, task selection by outcome or final C002 aggregation.
contrary_evidence: A prefix may differ from later episodes; episode counts are not training-seed replication. Poor linear probes or decoder masks do not prove absence of nonlinear information, and planning failure does not isolate encoder versus dynamics versus latent cost.

protocol.scope: immutable interim prefix and paired descriptive summary
protocol.selection: Read current cases.jsonl once, retain complete newline records, select all contiguous fully completed episodes from zero with horizons4/6/8; exclude any final incomplete episode without outcome-based filtering.
protocol.controls: Match exactly the same episode/horizon/start/goal/CEM-seed in completed L0/L1 and recorded/direct/true-CEM/hold/random controls; require original result reviews/digests.
protocol.inspection: Use unchanged qualified C009v2.audit_rows and inherited B003v2.audit_rows to independently reconstruct actions/endpoints/collisions on this prefix. Preserve source hashes and full snapshot bytes.
report: counts and endpoint success per horizon
protocol.uncertainty: Descriptive interim counts only; no sequential significance claim or population confidence intervals. Full3000case inspection/paired O1 and seed replications remain required.
protocol.next: Finish active O0 unchanged, then review and run matched O1; do not tune or stop based on this prefix.

success: Exact matched task coverage and independent saved-action physical scores; this attests an interim readout only.
stop: Stop interim analysis if source, reviewed parent, task or scoring checks fail; leave the active experiment untouched and preserve the failure.
